exports.title: Exports and backup
exports.intro: Every export runs under your own session and is never stored on the server. Each one is recorded in the audit log.
exports.individualHint: Leave the member field blank to download your own record.
exports.memberIdPlaceholder: Member ID (optional — leave blank for your own record)
exports.backupIntro: A monthly backup is mandatory while the congregation is on the Supabase free plan. The archive contains members, arrangements, reports, corrections, the audit log and settings — daily logs and return visits are never included.
exports.backupDialogDescription: You'll need this passphrase to open the backup file. Store it somewhere safe — it is never saved anywhere.
exports.passphraseHint: Anyone with this file and this passphrase can read the congregation's data. Share it only with the second Elder.
exports.backupFailed: The backup could not be created. Please try again.

settings.deleteAccountHint: Starts a 30-day grace period during which you can cancel. After that, an Elder gives final approval before your account is anonymized.
settings.requestDeletionWarning: You can cancel any time during the 30 days. After that, an Elder must approve before anything is removed, and past report numbers stay so congregation totals remain correct.
settings.deletionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
settings.deletionPending: Deletion requested. You can cancel until {date}.
